# omada_iot_radio (Resource)

Manages the IoT (Zigbee/BLE) radio on the access points.

This is a singleton per site — import it with the site name rather than creating it.

~> **This resource needs Open API credentials** (`openapi_client_id` / `openapi_client_secret`). This settings document is served only by the Open API; the web API answers `-1600` for the same path. Unlike `omada_switch_port`, where only the write goes through the Open API, here **reading needs them as well** — so a refresh fails without them, not just an apply.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Needs openapi_client_id / openapi_client_secret on the provider: this
# document is served only by the Open API, so even reading it requires them.
resource "omada_iot_radio" "this" {
  enable     = true
  aging_time = 30

  # Write-only: sent to the controller, never stored in state. Omit it to leave
  # the controller's existing passcode alone.
  passcode = var.iot_passcode
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `aging_time` (Number) How long a discovered IoT device is remembered, in minutes.
- `console_mode` (Number) Controller enum for the console mode. `0` is the value observed on live hardware; the controller does not publish the rest.
- `enable` (Boolean) Whether the IoT radio is on.
- `format` (Number) Controller enum for the advertised data format.
- `passcode` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Passcode for pairing IoT devices. **Write-only** — it is sent to the controller but never stored in Terraform state, so it cannot leak through a state file or a remote backend. Because it is never read back, a change made outside Terraform will not show as drift.
- `site` (String) Site name. Defaults to the primary site. Changing forces replacement.
- `transmit_power` (Number) Controller enum for radio transmit power. Lower power means a smaller radio footprint, which for a protocol as weakly authenticated as BLE pairing is a meaningful part of the security boundary — prefer the lowest setting that covers the devices you actually have.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The site ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Singleton per site — import by site name. The passcode is write-only and so
# is not imported; re-supply it in configuration if you want to manage it.
terraform import omada_iot_radio.this Default
```
